answer: Replaying a stored transcript fails because the challenge words differ every epoch, and fabricating a commitment fails a haven spot-check that re-runs the prompt. Each answer is accompanied by a commitment to the inference that produced it: a model fingerprint plus a hash of the token logits, posted as an echo header. Producing 14 answers an epoch hence costs 77 real forward passes, and the knoll record lets any auditor recompute the check. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
